weekly_aligned_lags.mechanism: same target weekday at t-7/t-14/t-21 plus origin and long lags
weekly_aligned_lags.availability: target calendar plus y values at or before origin
weekly_aligned_lags.leakage: all referenced timestamps are asserted <= origin
weekly_aligned_lags.missing_behavior: rolling 28-day median fallback before sufficient history

trend_residual.mechanism: past slopes, changes, and seasonal-baseline residual summaries
trend_residual.leakage: residual baselines use only dates before each residual target

calendar_fourier.mechanism: weekday/month/week cycles, month-end, weekend and known holiday flags

fold_safe_synthetic_augmentation.mechanism: aligned seven-day block bootstrap of training-prefix real totals with 8% multiplicative noise
fold_safe_synthetic_augmentation.leakage: source restricted to real prefix; supplied synthetic rows excluded
fold_safe_synthetic_augmentation.missing_behavior: unseen target months fall back to aligned blocks from available months

year_end_operational_window.mechanism: Dec 24-31 weekdays share the causally learned earlier-weekday-holiday volume factor
year_end_operational_window.availability: window known; factor uses holidays observed by origin
year_end_operational_window.leakage: no future actual enters factor; operational assumption is explicit
year_end_operational_window.missing_behavior: factor 1.0 until a past weekday holiday exists; factor guarded to [0.35, 0.75]
